newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-S.AFRICA WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST INDIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-S.AFRICA WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST INDIA.

text.p: South Africa won the toss and chose to bat in the day/night tri-nations series game against India at Springbok Park on Thursday.
South Africa: Gary Kirsten, Andrew Hudson, Lance Klusener, Daryll Cullinan, Jonty Rhodes, Hansie Cronje (captain), Shaun Pollock, Dave Richardson, Pat Symcox, Craig Matthews, Allan Donald.
India: Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Saurav Ganguly, Rahul Dravid, Mohammad Azharuddin, Ajay Jadeja, Robin Singh, Saba Karim, Anil Kumble, Javagal Srinath, Salil Ankola, Venkatesh Prasad.
